summary: Retest of the iteration_323 enterprise-gating issues. All four fixes are verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass, including two new tests: (1) /api/enterprise-config/me returns enterprise_enabled=false for a non-super_admin user with no tenant_id; (2) super_admin gets true. UI test on a temporary non-enterprise tenant with admin, general_manager and enterprise_owner. For all three roles, opening /enterprise-dashboard or /project-transfers-log directly redirects to '/'. On /warehouse-manufacturing they get no open-transfers-log-link and no settings-project-bar/project selectors. On /reports there are no enterprise tabs. Enterprise tenant admin (admin@maestroegp.com) regression: WM shows the project bar and the transfers-log link, and the link navigates correctly. The standalone /project-transfers-log and /enterprise-dashboard pages load. Reports tabs reports-tab-enterprise-dashboard and reports-tab-transfers-log both appear and both load embedded. The comparison and inventory charts show all 9 project names, angled, on the X axis (checked visually in a screenshot). Super admin owner@maestroegp.com logs in through the UI with secret 271018 and lands on /super-admin.

issues: Several texts are nearly invisible (dark text on a dark navy background): the 'إجمالي العملاء' and 'إجمالي المستخدمين' values, section headings above the plan cards and the sales section, the currency selector text, and customer names in the customers list. Probably pre-existing, not part of this change.
Shows the 'غير متصل' (socket disconnected) badge in the preview environment. Cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: fix the low-contrast texts on the /super-admin dark theme
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectTransfersLog still swallows API errors (catch -> setRows([])). An error state would be better.
tenantEnterpriseActive and enterpriseEnabled now differ only by the super_admin bypass. Consider consolidating them into one flag.
seed_data_creation: Temp tenant TEST_iter324_ui (admin/GM/enterprise_owner, password test1234) and TEST_iter323_nonent were created and then deleted. The temp no-tenant user was deleted too. The default tenant still has enterprise_enabled=true.
